branches.title: The World That Made You: philosophy and human experience
branches.relation: A human reading of the Bounded Observer programme, with source-traceable scientific bridges, disclosed fictional scenes and openly defended ethical commitments
branches.question: How does a person formed by a world learn to examine its conditions, act within them and help shape what another observer inherits?

contract.record: Versioned essays, the continuous book, source and illustration guides, scientific and historical anchors, and dated editorial review records
contract.normalization: Not applicable: philosophical interpretation and literary exposition are not a normalized positive-state model
contract.readings: The argument a reader can follow, its factual grounds, distinctions between source claims and interpretation, and the concrete questions or actions the exposition makes understandable
contract.operations: Read, compare with primary sources, distinguish fact from fiction or interpretation, challenge an argument, revise the wording and preserve the reason for a correction
contract.retained_state: Claim-specific source scope, scientific premises and empirical status, fictional-scene disclosure, the author's defended values, edition identity and consequential revision history
contract.composition: Continuous narrative and explicit relations among ideas and sources; no claim that human relationships or ethical arguments implement quantum tensor composition
contract.clock_resources: Edition and source-review dates, newsletter publication order and reader access; these editorial times are distinct from physical proper time or accumulated dissipative exposure
contract.bridge: Science enters through the conditions and observations of its cited model; human experience enters through philosophical interpretation and disclosed fiction; ethical commitments are stated and defended rather than inferred as physical theorems
contract.test_revision: Source and conceptual reviews precede release. Future reader comparisons must name the comprehension or usability question and preserve adverse findings. Corrections change a versioned text and its source guide together without erasing earlier editions

evidence.proof: The philosophical interpretation is an argument, not a new physical theorem. Cited mathematical results retain their named premises and source scope
evidence.numerical: No new numerical validation is supplied by the narrative. Cited calculations, competition receipts and failed comparisons retain their original identities and supported status
evidence.implementation: Six developed essays and a continuous illustrated twelve-chapter book have complete editorial sources and source-scoped reviews dated 13 October 2026. Reading editions and deployment status are recorded separately in the release manifest
evidence.empirical: Reader comprehension or practical benefit has not been established by a new reader study. The scientific and historical examples have individual evidence; literature does not independently confirm the whole framework

branches.next_task: Collect source-specific reader questions on the released reading editions and test a declared comprehension or usability improvement. Keep the completed book's human arc intact while the research programme continues through its actual open questions
